subject: SDK adoption checklist & endpoint cutover timeline
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Ramos <alex.ramos@bluelayer.com>, devops@bluelayer.com
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SDK adoption checklist & endpoint cutover timeline

Hi Alex / BlueLayer team,

Thanks again for the call yesterday — excited to see BlueLayer move from the Hosted API proof-of-concept to the Dedicated SDK path. Attached is a short checklist and two example artifacts to help the implementation sprint: a trimmed sample bundle with the client wiring and a cutover runbook.

High-level asks for the next 72 hours:
- Confirm which internal engineer will own the alpha cutover (name + calendar avail).
- Share the expected peak qps and typical token distribution (avg prompt tokens, avg response tokens).
- Try the attached sample (node + python) against the staging endpoint; call out any CORS/MTU/network blockers.

Key guidance we’ll follow in onboarding: SDK install -> auth -> endpoint pinning -> retry/timeout policy -> graceful rate-limit handling -> cutover smoke tests. See inline sample usage and a recommended policy for timeouts/backs off in the attached runbook.

I’ve cc’d Vivek (CSM) and Ben (Solutions Eng) — they’ll own the cutover checklist and can jump on a call to walk the sample code.

Thanks,
Monica
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
+1 (415) 555-0191

Attachments: bluelayer-sdk-samples.tar.gz (node/python examples), cutover-runbook-v1.pdf (checklist + smoke tests)

From: Alex Ramos <alex.ramos@bluelayer.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: devops@bluelayer.com, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SDK adoption checklist & endpoint cutover timeline

Thanks Monica — this looks great. Quick clarifying Qs from our side before we run the sample: 
1) Is the staging endpoint URL different for node vs python examples, or should both point to the same staging host?
2) For the retry policy in the runbook, do you recommend client-side exponential backoff plus a 429 handler that honors the Retry-After header?
3) We expect peak of ~150 qps and average prompt+response tokens ~850 combined during batch jobs.

I’ll have Marco (devops) run the node sample today and report back.

- Alex
Alex Ramos
Senior Platform Engineer, BlueLayer Health
alex.ramos@bluelayer.com

From: Marco Silva <devops@bluelayer.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 23 May 2027 09:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SDK adoption checklist & endpoint cutover timeline

Ben / Monica — I ran the node sample against staging. Quick notes:
- BASE_URL: staging.redwood.bluelayer.svc (works for both node/python)
- We hit a CORS preflight failure until we added OPTIONS to allowed methods on our proxy (fix in commit 37b).
- TLS handshake slow on our side; tuned keepalive and connection reuse, performance improved ~18%.
- One 429 at ~160 qps during a 30s burst; Retry-After header present (120s) and client respected it when we forced the header.

I can run a 10-minute load ramp if you want to validate retry windows.

—Marco
Marco Silva
Platform Engineer, BlueLayer Health

On Sat, May 22, 2027 at 11:03 AM Alex Ramos <alex.ramos@bluelayer.com> wrote:
> Thanks Monica — this looks great...

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Ramos <alex.ramos@bluelayer.com>, Marco Silva <devops@bluelayer.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 23 May 2027 13:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SDK adoption checklist & endpoint cutover timeline

Great troubleshooting notes Marco — thanks. Proposed cutover plan: 

1) Week 0 (today–Tue): BlueLayer runs 10m load ramp + smoke tests in staging. Capture token distribution and full request traces (we provided tracing headers in the sample).
2) Week 1 (Wed–Fri): Dry-run cutover during low-traffic window (02:00–05:00 PT) to redirect one service copy to Dedicated endpoints. Monitoring: per-route latency, 95/99 p99, 429/5xx counts, and token unit cost.
3) Week 2 (post-cutover): Full traffic migration, rollback policy in place (DNS rollback + client pin to previous model endpoint for 15m).

Action items: Alex to confirm who owns the Week 0 run and provide calendar slot for a 30-min pairing session with Ben (dev pairing) and me (CSM). Monica will send the invite and update the runbook with Marco’s proxy note.

I’ll also add a recommended client config snippet to the runbook (timeouts, batch size cap, retry window).

—Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Customer Success Director, Redwood Inference

Attachment: cutover-runbook-v1.pdf

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: SDK adoption checklist & endpoint cutover timeline

Perfect — Alex, thanks for confirming resource plan in-thread. Per action items:
- Alex -> please confirm Marco is owning Week 0 run (reply-all).
- Marco -> if you can run the 10m ramp tomorrow morning, Ben and I will join and capture client traces.
- I scheduled the 30-min pairing slot: Tue 2027-05-25 10:00–10:30 PT (calendar invite sent).

I updated the runbook to call out the CORS/OPTIONS proxy change and included the node snippet from Ben (see page 4). I also added a short checklist for the smoke tests (healthcheck endpoints, token distribution CSV).

If anything else comes up before the ramp, reply-all and we’ll triage. Looking forward to the cutover.

Thanks,
Monica
Monica Patel
